backups.title: Backups
backups.help: A copy of the database and of the media, overrides and extensions folders, saved in
backups.failed: The backup failed; see the server log
backups.restore_help: Backups do not contain secret.key or gorun.toml by default: keep your own protected copy. Use Inspect / Restore for a confined restore under data/restores/<stamp>/, or run gorun backup-restore --input … --dest <new-empty-dir>. Then copy secrets, stop processes on the old data directory, and serve with --data pointing at the restored directory. See docs/PRODUCTION.md.
backups.inspect_help: Preflight checks the local pair only. It does not prove a full site cutover or remote read-back.
backups.readiness.review_required: Review required — local pair looks usable; finish external checks before cutover.
backups.readiness.blocked: Blocked — fix the reported errors before restoring.
backups.restore_title: Restore to a new data directory
backups.restore_confined_help: Restore writes only into the path below (new empty directory). It never overwrites the live data directory while this process holds the SQLite lock.
backups.restore_confirm: Restore this backup into a new data directory under restores/? The live site will keep running until you stop it and point --data at the restored folder.
backups.restore_already: A restore for this stamp is already present.
backups.restore_next: Copy secret.key and gorun.toml (or set the original GORUN_SECRET_KEY), stop every process using the old data directory, then start GoRun with --data pointing at the restored path.
backups.restored: Backup restored into a new data directory under restores/. Copy secrets, stop the live process, then serve with --data on that folder.
backups.restore_exists: That restore directory already exists; remove or rename it before restoring again.
backups.restore_blocked: Restore blocked: the local pair failed preflight. See Inspect.
backups.restore_partial: An earlier restore was interrupted and left the partial directory below. Remove it on the server, then restore again.
backups.restore_failed: Restore failed; see the server log and Inspect.

backups.code.encrypted_upload_limit_exce: A file is larger than the encrypted remote upload limit.
backups.code.external_media_required: Some media lives in external storage (S3) and is not in this archive.
backups.code.external_reference_invalid: Some external media references are invalid.
backups.code.independent_original_secret: This backup has no secret.key: you need the original key, kept separately.
backups.code.remote_pair_not_confirmed: No confirmed remote copy of this pair.
backups.code.remote_readback_not_verifie: Reading the remote copy back has not been verified.
backups.code.writes_must_stop_for_full_c: Database and files are not one transaction: stop writes for a fully consistent copy.
backups.code.external_environment_not_ar: Environment variables and external settings are not archived.
backups.code.s3_objects_not_archived: Objects in S3-compatible storage are not archived.
backups.code.theme_bundles_not_archived: Theme folders shipped with the release are not archived.
backups.code.original_site_secret_requir: Restoring needs the original site secret (secret.key or GORUN_SECRET_KEY).

connections.title: Connections
connections.intro: Save named MCP, AI and S3 connections. Saving a profile does not prove connectivity. Tests run only when you request them.
connections.name: Connection name
connections.endpoint_help: Public HTTPS only. Private networks, URL credentials, query strings and redirects are blocked. MCP uses the exact HTTP endpoint; S3 uses a bare endpoint without a bucket path.
connections.ai_endpoint_help: For OpenAI-compatible providers include the API base path, usually /v1. Anthropic activation uses https://api.anthropic.com/v1. A model-list check does not verify generation or available credit.
connections.secret_help: Secrets are encrypted at rest and never displayed. Leave a field blank to keep its stored value.
connections.mcp_scope: Discovers tools using MCP 2025-11-25. No tools are executed or installed. Count covers the first returned page.
connections.ai_scope: Reads the model list only. Activate separately to use this connection for writing. Selected model:
connections.s3_scope: The connection test sends a signed, read-only bucket check. It does not activate storage. Choose an active destination in Storage.
connections.test_fail: Last check failed. Review endpoint, credentials, permissions and protocol.
connections.removal_note: Removing a connection does not revoke its credentials or change the active writing provider or saved storage destinations.
connections.invalid: Check the name, HTTPS endpoint, protocol-specific fields and credentials. Existing connection types cannot be changed.
connections.conflict: This connection changed. Reload before saving or testing again.
connections.saved: Connection saved. It has not been tested.
connections.activated: Writing configuration updated. Model generation has not been verified.
storage.title: Storage
storage.intro: Choose where new media and encrypted backups are stored. Saving or testing a connection does not activate it.
storage.activated: Storage destination configured. No files were uploaded by this action.
storage.disabled: New uploads disabled for this destination. Existing files remain accessible.
storage.media_default: Default storage (local disk or server S3 configuration)
storage.media_help: New uploads use this destination. Generated media is organized by site, content and date. Existing media keeps its original location.
storage.backup_help: Manual creation and upload only. Backup objects are encrypted before leaving the server and are never served as website media.
storage.recovery: Keep an independent copy of your site recovery secret (secret.key or GORUN_SECRET_KEY). Losing it makes encrypted backups unrecoverable. Upload limit: 64 MiB per backup file.
storage.retention: Changing buckets retains earlier destinations for existing files. Reactivate the same endpoint and bucket to refresh credentials. Connection deletion does not remove stored destinations or files.
storage.remote_success: Both encrypted backup files uploaded successfully.
storage.remote_failed: Remote upload failed. Any local backup that was created is retained; remote files may be incomplete.
storage.remote_unconfigured: Configure a backup destination in Storage first.
storage.remote_note: No scheduled backup is enabled. Only this explicit action creates and uploads a backup.

metricool.compose_intro: Review a social post, then send it to Metricool as a draft. Your website content is not selected or sent automatically.

metricool.date_help: Choose a future planning date within two years. Metricool requires this metadata even for drafts; GoRun always sends draft=true and autoPublish=false.
metricool.review: I reviewed this text and authorize sending it to this Metricool brand as a draft.

metricool.new: Start another draft after checking Metricool
metricool.boundary: Text drafts only. Your chosen network must already be connected in Metricool. Media, scheduling, public posting and analytics are not included. Up to 20 requests per user per hour.

backups.completeness_help: File presence does not prove a restore. Run backup-inspect for checksums, database integrity and external requirements. Database and files are not one transaction: stop writes for full consistency. S3 objects, external environment values and bundled themes are not archived. Upload receipts are provider acknowledgments; no remote read-back was verified.
